# Task G — packet captures

**These cannot be generated by a script — they must come off a real interface.**

Procedure: [`../../../scripts/capture-guide.md`](../../../scripts/capture-guide.md)
Budget 10 minutes.

Required files:

| File | Captured on | Shows |
|---|---|---|
| `G1-client-tls12.pcapng` | a client Mac | DNS + TCP handshake + TLS 1.2 handshake, certificate visible |
| `G2-client-tls13.pcapng` | a client Mac | same request on TLS 1.3, certificate encrypted |
| `G3-edge-to-backend.pcap` | the edge Mac | plain HTTP after TLS termination |

Verify each before committing — the self-check commands are at the end of the
capture guide. The commonest mistake is a missing DNS query because the OS
resolver cache was not flushed first.
